question.problem:
Consider the affine transformation $T,$ defined as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

What is the area scale factor of the transformation?
question.worked_solution:
The matrix representation of the linear transformation associated with $T$ is $A=[\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}].$ 

Computing the determinant of $A,$ we get

$$
det(A)=|\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}|=3\cdot 1-(-1)\cdot (-1)=2.
$$

So, the area scale factor of the transformation is

$$
|det(A)|=|2|=2.
$$
